hostprotocol.title: HOST PROTOCOL
hostprotocol.credits.line2: Attention. You have been designated a test subject.
hostprotocol.credits.line3: The identifier will be assigned by the system.
hostprotocol.credits.line4: You have entered the Host Protocol world.
hostprotocol.credits.line5: This world was discovered by accident. It is itself an error.
hostprotocol.credits.line6: The virus infects blocks, creatures, and reality itself.
hostprotocol.credits.line8: Your task: explore the world, find the source of infection, and eliminate the virus.
hostprotocol.credits.line9: You have one hundred days. If you fail, your body stays here without you.
hostprotocol.credits.line10: Protocol active. Good luck… if that word still means anything here.

hostprotocol.pda.title: HOST PROTOCOL
hostprotocol.pda.page1:
FIELD UNIT — DAY 1 BRIEFING
Device class: КПК / PDA
Subject: %s
Role: antivirus instance

You are bound to this identifier. The world does not know your name. It knows your number.
hostprotocol.pda.page2:
WORLD STATUS
Classification: ERROR
Infection index: 0.00 — not started
Local conditions: quiet. Fog possible.

You were injected into a place that should not exist. The world itself is the error. Observation is the first protocol.
hostprotocol.pda.page3:
STANDING ORDERS
1. Observe.
2. Survive.
3. Await further protocol entries.

Mission window: 100 days.
If the window closes, your body remains. You do not.
hostprotocol.pda.page4:
ANOMALY
Coordinates: pending
Next entry: scheduled

Do not lose this unit.
Host Protocol is watching.
End of entry.
hostprotocol.pda.day2.page1:
FIELD UNIT — DAY 2 LOG
Status: ANOMALY / INFECTION OBSERVED
Subject: %s
Infection index: TRACE — matter rewriting

The quiet was a lie. A focus is growing. Overlay covers the original block. Infected matter does not yield to tools.
hostprotocol.pda.day2.page2:
EARLY SCAN
Coordinates: %s
Scan integrity: partial
Recommendation: do not strike the overlay. Do not sleep as if the night is empty.

Focus remains loaded. Radius expands slowly.
Host Protocol is watching.
End of entry.
hostprotocol.pda.day3.page1:
FIELD UNIT — DAY 3 LOG
Status: FAILED HANDSHAKE / RESIDUAL TRACE
Subject: %s

Sensors caught a presence during the dropped link. Not a process. Something answered from the other side of the protocol, then the channel tore.
hostprotocol.pda.day3.page2:
DESIGNATION
Temporary label: SEPTIC?
Protocol code: HP-Δ / unconfirmed

It used a face. It was not the Error. It was an immune response wearing a name. Full contact is not authorized. Not yet.
hostprotocol.pda.day3.page3:
LINK DROPPED
The entity vanished when the handshake failed.
Residual echo on the bus — wrong subject-ID:
> SUBJECT %2$s — ACK
> [false system line] Host Protocol: you are already inside.

That number is not yours (%1$s). Discard the echo. Do not answer it.
hostprotocol.pda.day3.page4:
FORECAST
Further contact is scheduled after day 5.
Until then: observe the focus. Do not treat sleep as a safe skip.

Host Protocol is watching.
End of entry.
hostprotocol.pda.system.page1:
FIELD UNIT — SYSTEM ERROR
Status: HOST INFECTION / PDA COMPROMISED
Subject: %s

Sensor protocol torn. The log is writing over you. The system no longer classifies this unit as clean. Do not power it down. It is already inside.
hostprotocol.pda.system.page2:
SENSOR PROTOCOL
Class: SCANNER / blueprint unlocked
Craft chain: incomplete (lab pending).

Open the SCANNER tab. This is the first progression node. Full scanner assembly is out of scope for this build.
Host Protocol is watching.
End of entry.
